 :FILLER2_3 := NULL;

Trigger.TriggerText:
/*
NEW DECSUB CLASS
DESCRIPTION: CALLING PARAMETER
PROGRAMMER : AMER AL_QUHTANI
VERSION : 1,
DATE : 04/09/1428 
*/

DECLARE
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'LOV_USER_UPDATE_DATE';
 RET NUMBER;

BEGIN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE', TEXT_PARAMETER, 'قائمة بارقام النظام ');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_WIDTH', TEXT_PARAMETER, 7);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_X_POS', TEXT_PARAMETER, 1);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_Y_POS', TEXT_PARAMETER, 1);
 
/* IF :P_PORT_CD IS NOT NULL THEN
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'PORT_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, :P_PORT_CD);
 END IF;*/
 
 
 CALL_FORM('LOV_USER_UPDATE_DATE.fmx',NO_HIDE,NO_REPLACE,QUERY_ONLY,pl_id);

 IF :GLOBAL.ATTENTION_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN
 :FILLER2_1 := :GLOBAL.ATTENTION_DATE ;
-- :SAM := :GLOBAL.USR_ANAME;



 END IF;
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already exists!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
--GO_ITEM('TARIFF_GROUPS.GRP_CODE');
 END;

/*
NEW DECSUB CLASS
DESCRIPTION: TO PRINTER REPORT
PROGRAMMER : AMER AL_QUHTANI
VERSION : 1,
DATE : 04/09/1428 
*/
PROCEDURE PRINT_CHECK_VAL IS

 pl_id ParamList; 
 V_REPORT_FILE VARCHAR2(100); 
 V_COUNT NUMBER(5);
 

BEGIN 
 ----------------------------------------------------تم التحديث خلال المهلة-----------------------------------

 IF :RADIO_GROUP = 1 THEN
 SELECT count(*)
 into v_count
FROM
SC_USERS USR,
SC_USER_UPDATES SCUP,
SC_PORT_SETTING SCPS

WHERE
VAR_NAME = 'MESSAGE_DAYS'
AND USR. PORT_CD = SCUP. PORT_CD
AND USR. USER_ID = SCUP.USER_ID
AND (SCUP.ATTENTION_DATE = :FILLER2_1)-- OR :FILLER2_1 IS NULL)
AND SCUP.UPDATE_DATE IS NOT NULL
AND SCUP.SUSPENSION_DATE IS NULL ;
 
---------------------------------------------------تم التحديث حتى الأن------------------------------------------
 ELSIF :RADIO_GROUP = 2 THEN

 SELECT count(*)
 into v_count

FROM
SC_USERS USR,
SC_USER_UPDATES SCUP,
SC_PORT_SETTING SCPS

WHERE
VAR_NAME = 'MESSAGE_DAYS'
AND USR. PORT_CD = SCUP. PORT_CD
AND USR. USER_ID = SCUP.USER_ID
AND (SCUP.ATTENTION_DATE = :FILLER2_2)-- OR :FILLER2_2 IS NULL)
AND SCUP.UPDATE_DATE IS NOT NULL ;

----------------------------------------------------لم يتم التحديث خلال المهلة وتم ايقافهم--------------------------
 ELSIF :RADIO_GROUP = 3 THEN

 SELECT count(*)
 into v_count
FROM
SC_USERS USR,
SC_USER_UPDATES SCUP,
SC_PORT_SETTING SCPS

WHERE
VAR_NAME = 'MESSAGE_DAYS'
AND USR. PORT_CD = SCUP. PORT_CD
AND USR. USER_ID = SCUP.USER_ID
AND (SCUP.ATTENTION_DATE = :FILLER2_3)-- OR :FILLER2_3 IS NULL)
AND SCUP.UPDATE_DATE IS NULL
AND SCUP.SUSPENSION_DATE IS NOT NULL ;

----------------------------------------------------لم يتم التحديث حتى الأن--------------------------------------------
 ELSIF :RADIO_GROUP = 4 THEN

 SELECT count(*)
 into v_count
FROM
SC_USERS USR,
SC_USER_UPDATES SCUP,
SC_PORT_SETTING SCPS

WHERE
VAR_NAME = 'MESSAGE_DAYS'
AND USR. PORT_CD = SCUP. PORT_CD
AND USR. USER_ID = SCUP.USER_ID
AND (SCUP.ATTENTION_DATE = :FILLER2_4)-- OR :FILLER2_4 IS NULL)
AND SCUP.UPDATE_DATE IS NULL
AND SCUP.SUSPENSION_DATE IS NULL ;

 END IF;

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------->> 
 IF v_count > 0 then 
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Destroy_Parameter_List( pl_id ); 
 END IF; 
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'PRINTER'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PRINTJOB',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:parameter.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_MODULE_NAME);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_CLASS_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_MODULE_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_MODULE_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,:REPORT_NO);
 
 --Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_FILLER2_1',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_DATE(:FILLER2_1,'MI-MM-RRRR'));
 --MESSAGE(TO_CHAR(:FILLER2_1,'MI-MM-YYYY'));
 --MESSAGE(TO_CHAR(:FILLER2_1,'MI-MM-YYYY'));
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_FILLER2_1',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:FILLER2_1,'MI-MM-YYYY'));
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_FILLER2_2',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:FILLER2_2,'MI-MM-YYYY'));
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_FILLER2_3',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:FILLER2_3,'MI-MM-YYYY'));
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_FILLER2_4',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:FILLER2_4,'MI-MM-YYYY'));
 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_RADIO_GROUP',TEXT_PARAMETER,:RADIO_GROUP);
 
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 V_REPORT_FILE := :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_PATH||:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE;
 REP.Run_Product( REPORTS , V_REPORT_FILE , SYNCHRONOUS, RUNTIME , FILESYSTEM , pl_id , NULL); 
 ELSE
 
 MESSAGE('لا يوجد سجلات تحقق المطلوب'); 
 MESSAGE(' لا يوجد سجلات تحقق المطلوب');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 
END ;
